tbesh_html:
Behemoth
This name means perhaps an extinct dinosaur
1a) a Diplodocus or Brachiosaurus, exact meaning unknown 1b) hippopotamus
1c) a mythical or proverbial creature

strongs_1890.strongs_def: a water-ox, i.e. the hippopotamus or Nile-horse
strongs_1890.derivation: in form a plural or H929 (בְּהֵמָה), but really a singular of Egyptian derivation;
